summary: Gray Media, Inc. filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) on November 6, 2026, disclosing that its Board of Directors authorized a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.08 per share on its common stock and Class A common stock. The dividend is payable December 31, 2026, to holders of record at the close of business on December 15, 2026. A press release was furnished as Exhibit 99.1. No advisor, premium, or structural/regulatory terms are stated. This is an ordinary capital-return announcement, not a special situation; no deal or risk-arb angle applies.
